content_zh:
秦漠只感觉到有什么东西扑进了自己的怀里，左脚向后一撤，深邃的黑眸沉了下去。
“秦总！！”
跟在秦漠身后的秘书满头大汗的叫了起来，想要把自家总裁拉开，但是已经来不及了……
博九失去重心的那一瞬，眼睛便凌厉的眯了起来。
然而还没有给她发威的时间，周围就陷入了一片寂静。
是她的错觉吗？
怎么脖子后面都是凉的？
反倒是掌心下一片的温热，硬硬的，还挺好摸…
博九那动了两下手的动作，被学校的领导完完全全的看在眼里，吓的那主任脸色都白了！
“博九！“教导主任恨不得把这人一把提溜出去，他怎么也没有想到这小子会忽然直接冒出来，不是告诉过他们，别让他再出现了吗？！
霍思雨听着这道低吼，高兴的笑了起来，这一下，博九这个土包子铁定死！
“博九？那不就是上次缠着秦少背影不放的那个人吗？”
“他还真是不死心啊，他就不怕秦少弄死他？”
“脑袋有问题呗，看来男人花痴起来，也挺让人无语的。”
听着周围的议论声，最想要捂住自己双眼的人就是陈晓东，他怎么也没有想到他最担心的事，竟然会在这么人面前上演。
他还以为这些天来少爷变了。
没有想到啊，都是为了降低他防备心用出来的套路。
他刚刚不应该站在Ａ班，应该混到Ｄ班去，这样还能在少爷失去理智想要抱秦少之前，抓住少爷的腿！
此时，博九也不是那么痛快，她也是被害者好吗？
不过看大家的样子，铁定也不会相信她了。

干脆不做不休，既然做了就做到底。
想到这里，博九扬唇一笑，突地抓住了男人的衣领，朝着那张俊美冰冷的脸凑了过去，嗓音邪佞：“哥们，身材不错。＂
这，这是调戏？！
张晓东一身的冷汗冒了出来，少爷你真的是疯了，疯了啊！
撩妹子就算了，居然敢撩秦少，你不知道那是头老虎吗！
人们确实没有想到博九会说出这样的话来。
那边的喵系少年由于过于惊愕，已经快把怀里的兔子耳朵咬断了。
校领导们则是恨不得博九这个学生能立刻在他们眼前消失！
秦漠的眼神也冷到了极点。
可比起冷来，让人神经紧绷的却是他那股狠劲儿。
睥睨天下，王者气魄。
博九现在相信了陈晓东的话，这个男人是真的不好惹。
只是忽然之间，他那张脸一下子逼近，矜贵俊美在这一刻全部被打破，只剩下了令人不安的压迫感……
他俯身，寒气十足的气息打在了她的耳后：“博九是吗？放学回家的时候看着点，因为很有可能会被人揍的断了右手。”
他说的风清云淡，声音低的只有彼此才能察觉到。
但博九还是听出了他话里的另外一层意思，她刚刚就是用右手摸的他的胸，这位被她吃了豆腐的秦少爷是想打断她的右手？

content_en:
Qin Mo only felt something rushing into his arms. He moved his left foot back and his deep black eyes darkened.
"Mr. Qin!!"
The secretary who was following Qin Mo started sweating profusely and wanted to pull his CEO away, but it was too late...
The moment Bo Jiu lost his center of gravity, his eyes narrowed sharply.
However, before she had time to show off her power, the surroundings fell into silence.
Is it her imagination?
Why is the back of my neck so cold?
On the contrary, there is a patch of warmth under the palm of my hand, which is hard and easy to touch...
Bo Jiu's move of moving his hands twice was completely seen by the school leaders, who was so frightened that the director's face turned pale!
"Bo Jiu!" The dean wanted to rush this man out. He never expected that this kid would suddenly appear directly. Didn't he tell them not to let him appear again? !
Hearing this low roar, Huo Siyu laughed happily. This time, Bo Jiu, a bumpkin, was definitely dead!
"Bo Jiu? Isn't that the person who pestered Mr. Qin's back last time?"
"He really doesn't want to give up. Isn't he afraid that Master Qin will kill him?"
"There's something wrong with your head. It seems that when a man becomes a nymphomaniac, it's quite speechless."
Listening to the discussions around him, the person who wanted to cover his eyes the most was Chen Xiaodong. He never thought that what he was most worried about would be performed in front of such a person.
He thought the young master had changed these days.
I didn't expect that it was all a trick to lower his defensiveness.
He shouldn't have been standing in Class A just now, he should have been in Class D, so that he could grab the young master's leg before he lost his mind and wanted to hug Young Master Qin!
At this time, Bo Jiu was not so happy. She was also a victim, okay?
But judging from everyone’s looks, they definitely wouldn’t believe her.
Just don’t stop doing it, and once you’ve done it, do it to the end.
Thinking of this, Bo Jiu raised his lips and smiled, suddenly grabbed the man's collar, moved towards the handsome and cold face, and said in a sinister voice: "Brother, you have a good figure."
This, is this teasing? !
Zhang Xiaodong broke out in cold sweat, Master, you are really crazy, crazy!
Forget about flirting with girls, you actually dare to flirt with Young Master Qin, don’t you know that’s a tiger!
People really didn't expect Bo Jiu to say such words.
The meow boy over there was so shocked that he almost bit off the ears of the rabbit in his arms.
The school leaders wished that the student Bo Jiu could disappear immediately before their eyes!
Qin Mo's eyes were also extremely cold.
But compared to the coldness, what made people nervous was his fierceness.
Looking down at the world, he has the spirit of a king.
Bo Jiu now believed Chen Xiaodong's words, this man was really not easy to mess with.
But suddenly, his face suddenly approached, and all his dignity and beauty were broken at this moment, leaving only an unsettling sense of oppression...
He leaned over, and his cold breath hit behind her ear: "Is it Bo Jiu? Watch carefully when you get home from school, because you may get beaten up and lose your right hand."
He spoke in a clear voice, and his voice was so low that only the other party could detect it.
But Bo Jiu still heard another meaning in his words. She had touched his chest with her right hand just now. Did the young master Qin who she had eaten so hard wanted to break her right hand?
If you like the national school girl, please be a girl.
